_about: Zernio: publishing reels and answering comments through the official Instagram API (client: publish/zernio.mjs). Key: ~/.config/serials/zernio.env, never in git. Accounts are entered under neutral keys with userHash (a one-way hash of the Instagram username): this repository is public and names neither the accounts nor their reels. accountId is filled in by publish/health.mjs when the owner connects the account.
